description: This file is a shell script used for managing the NTP client service. It includes functions for starting, stopping, and initializing the service, handling timezone configurations, NTP server selection, and synchronization attempts. The script also manages cron jobs for retries and interacts with system configuration and event mechanisms to control the NTP synchronization process.

methods.name: prepare_retry_soon_file
methods.description: Prepares a cron job to retry NTP sync every minute if initial attempt fails.

methods.name: service_start
methods.description: Starts the NTP client service, sets timezone, selects the NTP server, attempts synchronization, and updates system status.

methods.name: service_init
methods.description: Initializes the service by fetching configuration parameters.
